per_depth.common_affordance: The explicit guarantee that every impossible instance is certified by one of the two local tests: a job with p1 + p2 > T or a machine with total load > T.
The statement directly identifies the only accepted certificate types with simple additive inequalities, so no schedule construction or search is needed.
The statement explicitly defines certificates as simple isolated-job and independent-frequency raw-sum violations, while guaranteeing that exactly one category applies.
